name: prettier-after-edit
description: Format Codex-edited files with the target project's local Prettier after supported edit events.

interface.shortDescription: Format edited files with local Prettier.
interface.longDescription: Prettier After Edit packages a PostToolUse hook and skill for exact-file formatting after supported Codex edit events. It uses the target project's local Prettier API, respects repository configuration and ignore files, and skips rather than installing dependencies.
capabilities: Distinct formatted, unchanged, skipped, and failed statuses
defaultPrompt: Use $prettier-after-edit to format Codex-edited files with the target project's local Prettier.
